svg.title: The whole app in six moves, from the installer to checking its claims
svg.desc: An animated six panel walkthrough. One: run the installer, per machine, requiring administrator, with the Visual C++ redistributable inside it, and it asks for one restart. Two: pick where to come out, from 74 countries on the globe or in the popup, or let it take the fastest exit the live relay list offers. Three: press Connect, seven stages in the app's own words with Tor's bootstrap forwarded verbatim, and the exit read back through the circuit. Four: the machine follows, system proxy on 127.0.0.1, DNS pinned to Tor, ports 53 and 853 shut elsewhere, IPv6 blocked both ways, 14 browsers told the same country. Five: switching country re-pins the exit and clears each browser's cache, cookies and history browser wide, and a list of domains can bypass the tunnel live. Six: check it yourself, from the plain text log and the 111 probe scripts.

g.text: WALKTHROUGH

svg.text: Installer to connected, and everything after it — six moves, in order

g.text: Per-machine NSIS setup, marked
requireAdministrator. The Visual C++
redistributable is inside it. Then it asks
for one restart, and waits for a yes.
74 countries, on a globe you can spin,
or in the popup inside your browser.
Choose nothing and it takes the fastest
one the live relay list can offer.

svg.text: pinned in the torrc with StrictNodes 1

g.text: Seven stages in the app’s own words,
with Tor’s bootstrap forwarded verbatim.
The exit is then read back through the
circuit it just built, not assumed.
System proxy on 127.0.0.1, DNS pinned
to Tor, ports 53 and 853 shut everywhere
else, IPv6 blocked both ways, and 14
browsers told the exit’s own country.
A switch re-pins the exit, then clears
each browser’s cache, cookies and history
browser-wide, so you are signed out.
A domain list can bypass the tunnel live.
A plain-text log in ProgramData records
what it wrote, and what a read-back then
found. 111 probe scripts drive the real
registry, and the real browsers.

svg.text: no account, no telemetry, no update check
